message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code uses `dvc pull` to fetch remote data/models but performs no checksum verification, signature check, or pinned-revision authentication on the retrieved artifacts.
No detected label flipping detection: The code only applies LabelEncoder to the target variable without any validation of expected label values, distribution checks, or label-noise detection tools.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious input filtering steps applied to the training data before or during preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The model is loaded via joblib.load() in multiple places without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; no integrity verification is performed before loading.
No detected label distribution validation: No class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomaly detection on training samples is performed before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses a standard scikit-learn RandomForestClassifier with no differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) applied.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no adversarial robustness testing present; the code only uses standard sklearn metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1) with no Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or other adversarial attack libraries.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics are computed (accuracy, precision, recall, F1), there is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or other controls to prevent metric manipulation; evaluation data integrity is not enforced.
No detected output bounds checks: The inference path calls slicePredict and directly converts the result to a string with no NaN checks, probability bounds validation, or output sanity guards.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses a RandomForestClassifier on tabular data, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable.
